gtc.text: Nikya of the Old Ways, leader of the Zhur-Taa clan, sends Kal to watch the Izzet from an abandoned Orzhov spire to make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory.
She then gathers the Zhur-Taa at the Speaking Mound and declares that they have the right to claim bloodcrime and seek vengeance from the Rakdos, and she picks her war-party.
In the fight Nikya entangles a Rakdos ogre in a wall of vines, and afterward she holds up a bloodwitch's charred head, revealing that Massacre Girl escaped but Kal killed a bloodwitch.
